scope: Great Ape and boss-exclusive skill taxonomy corrections

corrections.name: Energy Cannon
corrections.effect: Creates turrets that fire a volley of small Ki Blasts followed by three larger Ki Blasts.
corrections.reason: Dedicated Xenoverse skill documentation explicitly categorizes Energy Cannon as Super and Ki Blast and identifies Final Form Demigra as its user.

corrections.name: Boulder Toss
corrections.character_source: Great Ape Nappa; Great Ape Vegeta
corrections.effect: Great Ape picks up and throws a large boulder.
corrections.reason: Batch 283 used Other conservatively. Current Xenoverse 2 quest documentation identifies Boulder Toss as a Great Ape skill and the technique is a physical boulder throw, supporting Strike classification.

corrections.name: Boulder Break
corrections.character_source: Great Ape Nappa; Great Ape Bardock
corrections.effect: Great Ape slams a large boulder into the ground.
corrections.reason: Batch 283 used Other conservatively. The technique is a physical boulder attack and current Great Ape skill documentation supports Strike classification.

records.name: Darkness Mixer
records.effect: Ki and Stamina charging Super with a damaging dark aura.
records.notes: Source's Unavailable for CaC category lists Darkness Mixer.

records.name: Pretty Charge
records.notes: Source explicitly categorizes it as Other Super and Unavailable for CaC.

records.name: Energy Jet
records.effect: Large Ki ball projectile followed by a finishing explosion.
records.notes: Source explicitly categorizes it as Ki Blast Ultimate and Unavailable for CaC.

records.name: Ice Claw
records.character_source: Eis Shenron; Omega Shenron Customize Partner
records.unlock_method: Shenron wish: I want a new Super Attack!
records.effect: Short-range claw strikes that blind the opponent.

records.name: Gigantic Omega
records.character_source: Broly; Broly (Full Power Super Saiyan); Kefla (Super Saiyan) Customize Partner
records.effect: Throws a large Ki projectile; damage varies by distance.

records.name: Giant Storm
records.character_source: Nappa; Raditz, Broly, Omega Shenron, Kefla (Super Saiyan), and other Customize Partners
records.effect: Creates a large explosion beneath the target; long-range tracking Ki Blast Ultimate.

notes: Reconciles previously uncovered cast/boss skills and taxonomy corrections. Energy Cannon, Boulder Toss, and Boulder Break are formal corrections. Darkness Mixer, Pretty Charge, Energy Jet, Ice Claw, Gigantic Omega, and Giant Storm are retained as research records. Pretty Charge and Energy Jet are explicitly unavailable for CaC in current Xenoverse 2 documentation; Darkness Mixer is also listed in the unavailable-for-CaC category. Giant Storm is a CaC skill obtained from the Skill Shop, while Gigantic Omega is a Strike Super obtained from Broly training.
